backend/main.mo: Motoko backend actor managing study sessions, Pomodoro timers, and user goals with functions to record sessions, track distractions, manage timer state, and query session data stored in maps and sets.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting UI redesign implementation across components with minimal design, hero section creation, feature cards, and visual clutter reduction mapped to test requirements.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Comprehensive summaries of all frontend TypeScript/React components describing their redesigned minimal UI, functionality, and integration with timer, camera monitoring, dashboard, and theme systems.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables defining light and dark theme color schemes using oklch color space for backgrounds, foregrounds, borders, charts, and sidebar components.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the FocusGuard application with root div and module script reference to main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root application component configuring TanStack Router with routes for HomePage, TimerPage, and DashboardPage, wrapped in ThemeProvider with system theme support and shared Header/Footer layout.
frontend/src/components/CameraMonitor.ts: Floating camera monitor card component displaying live video feed with status badges for face presence, phone detection, and seated status, featuring minimize/maximize toggle and rounded minimal design.
frontend/src/components/CyclePrompt.tsx: Modal dialog prompting users after break completion to either start the next Pomodoro cycle or end the study session with two action buttons.
frontend/src/components/Dashboard.tsx: Main dashboard component displaying study statistics, metrics (total/focused time, focus score, streak), weekly/daily graphs, insights, and goal progress using multiple UI cards and charts.
frontend/src/components/DistractionWarni: Alert dialog component that displays context-specific warnings (phone detected, sleeping, face not detected, not seated) to redirect user attention back to studying.
frontend/src/components/FeatureCard.tsx: Reusable card component for displaying features with an icon/image, title, and description, including hover animations and configurable delay.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Footer component displaying copyright, attribution with heart icon, and a referral link to caffeine.ai with UTM tracking parameters.
frontend/src/components/GoalSetting.tsx: Card component for viewing and editing daily study goals in hours and minutes, with save/cancel functionality using the useStudyGoals hook.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Sticky header navigation with logo, navigation buttons (Home, Timer, Dashboard), and theme toggle, using TanStack Router for navigation.
frontend/src/components/MotivationalQuot: Card component that displays rotating motivational quotes, changing every 5 minutes with a quote icon and styled text.
frontend/src/components/MusicControlButt: Button component for toggling focus music playback, showing different styles and animations based on playing state.
frontend/src/components/MusicPlayer.tsx: Dialog-based music player with category selection, volume control, loop mode, playlist management, and audio file import functionality using the useAudioPlayer hook.
frontend/src/components/SiteBlockWarning: Alert dialog that notifies users when they attempt to access blocked websites during study sessions, displaying the site name and remaining session time.
frontend/src/components/StudyGraph.tsx: Bar chart component using Recharts to visualize daily study hours data with customized styling and tooltips.
frontend/src/components/StudyTimer.tsx: React component that implements a focus timer with Pomodoro and custom modes, auto-pause on distraction detection (phone, head down, face lost), and cycle management with motivational quotes.
frontend/src/components/ThemeToggle.tsx: React component that provides a button to toggle between light and dark themes using next-themes, with sun/moon icons.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom React hook that manages the backend actor instance using React Query, creating authenticated or anonymous actors based on Internet Identity and invalidating dependent queries on actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAudioPlayer.ts: Custom React hook that manages audio playback with multiple music categories, custom playlists stored in IndexedDB, volume control, loop mode, and auto-play functionality.
frontend/src/hooks/useDistractionDetecti: Custom React hook that detects user distraction by monitoring browser visibility changes and window focus/blur events, tracking distraction start time.
frontend/src/hooks/useFaceDetection.ts: Custom React hook that performs basic face detection using canvas-based skin tone and brightness analysis, detecting face presence, head-down position, and face loss duration with smoothing algorithms.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Custom React hook and provider for Internet Identity authentication on ICP, managing login/logout state, identity persistence, and AuthClient configuration with delegation validation.
frontend/src/hooks/useObjectDetection.ts: Custom React hook that performs real-time phone detection using edge detection on video frames from a webcam, analyzing rectangular objects and tracking detection history with configurable confidence thresholds.
frontend/src/hooks/usePoseDetection.ts: Custom React hook that detects whether a user is seated or standing by analyzing vertical brightness distribution in video frames, using an adaptive baseline calibration system to accommodate different study postures.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: React Query hooks for fetching all study sessions and recording new sessions to the backend actor, with automatic cache invalidation on mutations.
frontend/src/hooks/useSiteBlocker.ts: Custom React hook that simulates detection of blocked social media sites (YouTube, Instagram, Facebook, etc.) with a note that actual blocking requires a browser extension.
frontend/src/hooks/useStudyGoals.ts: Custom React hook for managing daily study goals stored in localStorage, with a default of 120 minutes and progress tracking functionality.
frontend/src/hooks/useStudyStats.ts: Custom React hook that calculates comprehensive study statistics including daily/weekly hours, focus scores, streaks, distraction metrics, and performance insights from session data retrieved via React Query.
frontend/src/hooks/useTimer.ts: Custom React hook managing Pomodoro and custom study timers with automatic pause/resume on distraction detection, tracking focused time, breaks, distractions, and recording completed sessions to the backend.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom design tokens for light/dark themes using a soft blue color palette, plus utility classes for animations, shadows, and smooth transitions.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React Query and Internet Identity providers, then renders the root App component.
frontend/src/pages/DashboardPage.tsx: Simple page component that renders the Dashboard component within a container with padding.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Landing page component with hero section, feature cards showcasing camera monitoring, focus music, distraction blocking, and study analytics, plus navigation buttons to timer and dashboard pages.
frontend/src/pages/TimerPage.tsx: Main timer page that orchestrates study sessions by integrating StudyTimer, CameraMonitor, MusicPlayer, and multiple detection hooks (face, object, pose) with distraction and site blocking warnings.
frontend/src/utils/audioStorage.ts: IndexedDB utility module for storing, retrieving, deleting, and listing audio files organized by playlist, with support for saving File objects as ArrayBuffers.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom theme extensions including OKLCH color system, container settings, custom spacing/font sizes, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Project metadata documenting FocusGuard's architecture (React/TypeScript frontend, TensorFlow.js/MediaPipe for detection, local processing), known browser/API limitations, and implemented features including timer, camera monitoring, and distraction detection.
